_: The reference pixel-anode geometry: the configuration every number in
_1: RESULTS.md was measured with. 5x5 periodic supercell, 4.434 mm pitch,
_2: 3.048 mm pad / 1.386 mm gap, 53.208 mm drift at 500 V/cm.
_3: Every Config field is given explicitly, so this file is the complete
_4: input to a run -- nothing is left to a code default. Keys beginning
_5: with _ are comments and are ignored on load.
_output: where every stage writes its files
_geometry: all lengths in mm. pitch and pad_width must both be integer multiples of h_min = pitch/2**lmax, and drift_length must be a whole number of pitches; violations raise rather than snapping. npad is the N x N transversely periodic supercell. drift_length is anode plane to cathode
_field: drift field in V/cm between the anode plane (z=0) and the cathode
_mesh: coarsening away from the anode: cell size ~ distance_to_anode/grade
_solver: BiCGSTAB relative-residual target and iteration cap; float64 is the default, see RESULTS.md Test 5 for the float32 path
_export: resampled-grid export: spacing = pitch/grid_div, and the near-anode fine grid is slab pitches thick
_drift: electron survey: ngrid x ngrid start points; waveform sample tick in us; pad_after us of baseline after each waveform. pad_before is the one value not fixed here: null means 20% of the longest drift time, which is not known until the paths have been tracked. Set a number in us to pin it
_response: response table: paths per pixel, half-width in pixels, electron start height in mm, sub-pixel offset in pitch units, output units, RNG seed
_derived: h_min 138.6 um; pad 3.048375 mm = 22 h_min; gap 1.385625 mm = 10 h_min; drift 53.208 mm = 12 pitches; E 50.0 V/mm
